name: skills
description: A collection of AI agent skills for working with Expo projects and Expo Application Services
one_liner: An official instruction pack that teaches AI coding assistants exactly how to build, deploy and upgrade mobile apps correctly using Expo's app-building framework, instead of guessing and making framework mistakes.
buyer: A mobile app development agency that builds client apps with Expo and wants faster, more reliable AI-assisted delivery with fewer framework-specific errors.
business_use_cases: A mobile dev agency installs it across all client projects so AI-assisted app builds follow Expo's current best practices instead of outdated patterns.
A freelance mobile developer uses the upgrade and app-store skills to safely handle SDK upgrades and store submissions for clients without re-learning the process each time.
A startup's single engineer uses it to confidently ship a native-feeling app without a dedicated mobile specialist on the team.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a fixed-price 'Expo app build or SDK upgrade' service to small businesses, using the skills to cut delivery time and error risk.

steal_this: It's a free official tool, not a resellable product — the fastest move is using it to take on one small 'build my app' client project this weekend and pricing it based on the time it saves you.
